Lemma
[The gradient is orthogonal to the kernel of the differential]

↗ def:gradient ↗ lem:gradient-characterization

Let $(M,g)$ be a finite-dimensional Riemannian manifold, $f\colon M\to \mathbb R$ smooth, and $p\in M$. If $w\in T_pM$ satisfies $df_p(w)=0$, then $\langle \operatorname {grad}f|_p,w\rangle =0$.

Proof

↗ lem:gradient-characterization \sketch Equation (2.14) identifies the two quantities.

□
